ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution via Nice - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "nice" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/nice$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/bash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/dash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/fish$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/sh$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/zsh$")))
